definition: [ קוֺט ] dubious verb intransitive , assumed meaning break, snap (supposed to be akin to Arabic cut, cut off, pare, trim [whence Buhl assumes √ קטט ]), to account for יְקוֺט Job 8:14 , either as Qal Imperfect 3 masculine singular whose hope snappeth ; or as noun [masculine] = fragile thing (|| בֵּית עַכָּבִישׁ ; compare Di Bu ); probably corrupt; Du Beer read קוּרִים Bu conjecture קֻרֵי קַיִט [Aramaism for קַיִץ ׳ ק ].
